results.description:
Metalstorm is an online competitive shooter where matches are decided by skill, positioning, and team coordination. Jump into real-time multiplayer battles against real players, master distinct combat roles and jets, and compete in fast-paced air combat built for serious PvP players. Played by millions of players worldwide, Metalstorm delivers modern warfare for competitive shooter fans.


Master your role, win the fight, and climb toward ace status.




COMPETITIVE 5V5 MULTIPLAYER COMBAT
Metalstorm is built for skill-based PvP and team coordination.

- Online 5v5 Battles: Fight with your squad in real-time multiplayer modes like Team Deathmatch, Air Superiority, and Elimination
- Fast Matchmaking: Jump into quick 6-minute matches with real players in seconds.
- Global Rankings: Climb the global leaderboards and prove your status as a legendary ace in our PvP modes
- Team-Based Air Combat: Master your guns and own the sky in a game built for action, not simulation


DISTINCT COMBAT ROLES & JET ABILITIES
Every aircraft in Metalstorm fills a unique combat role. Choose your playstyle and adapt your strategy with 5 distinct class roles and over 42 authentic jets to choose from like: 

- Frontline Tank (A-10 Thunderbolt): Tank damage and dominate close-range combat with iconic guns
- Stealth Assassin (JAS39 Gripen): Ambush enemies with precision strikes and vanish
- Recon Scout (F-35 Lightning): Provide overwatch for your team with battlefield intel
- Sharpshoot Sniper (F-14 Tomcat): Control airspace with multi-lock missile systems
- Tactical Support (Rafale): Disrupt enemy targeting with advanced electronic warfare


BUILD, UPGRADE, AND CUSTOMIZE YOUR ARSENAL
Progress through a deep upgrade system designed for long-term mastery and competitive balance. Modify your fleet like a real warfare strategist to fit the needs of your multiplayer team:

- Jet Stats: Upgrade speed, durability, and guns across 20 levels
- Mods: Customize jets with damage resistance, gun boosts, and high-skill maneuvering upgrades
- Unique Ability: Unlock powerful ultimate abilities that can change the course of battle
- Licensed Aircraft: Fly officially licensed aircraft from Lockheed Martin, Boeing, and Northrop Grumman, including the F-16 Fighting Falcon, F-22 Raptor, F/A-18 Super Hornet, and F-14 Tomcat


LIVE EVENTS, SEASONS & REGULAR UPDATES
The action never stops. Metalstorm is a live multiplayer game with constant new content and limited-time challenges.

- Seasonal Battle Pass: Complete missions to unlock customizations and upgrade resources
- Weekly & Limited-Time Events: Experience rotating game modes and special challenges

- Black Market: Prepare for new jet releases with squad-based challenges and event rewards


SQUAD UP WITH FRIENDS
Join a Squadron of warriors and compete together in the most social online multiplayer game on mobile. Chat strategy with teammates and climb the Squadron Leaderboards together. Whether you’re a casual action fan or a hardcore competitive shooter, Metalstorm offers a social multiplayer experience built around teamwork and progression.


EPIC MAPS & OPTIMIZED PERFORMANCE
Battle across dynamic maps designed for tactical air combat. Use terrain, cover, and altitude to outplay opponents across environments like icy arctic battlefields and high-risk nuclear facilities. Enjoy high-definition visuals and smooth performance optimized for mobile devices.


Download Metalstorm: Modern Air Combat now and experience one of the most competitive online jet PvP shooters. Jump in the cockpit and earn your place among the world’s top aces.

results.description:
Grab the control yoke of a warplane and jump into the battlefields of World War 2 in this thrilling combat flight action game. In each of the campaigns for USA, Great Britain, USSR, Germany and Japan you will assume the role of a pilot and squadron leader of an elite air force unit, established for the most dangerous and strategic missions that can turn the tide of war.
In Warplanes: WW2 Dogfight you take control of over 50 historical airplanes – from classic fighters to light and heavy bombers. Spitfire, P-51, Hurricane, Lancaster, Il-2 “Shturmovik”, La-5FN, Ju-87 “Stuka”, Fw 200 “Condor” and B-17 “Flying Fortress” are only a few of the beautiful machines that you can fly, repaint, customize and upgrade.
Gather a squadron of the best pilots and train them to assist you in the most risky missions. If you need an additional adrenaline rush, you can go on a mission by yourself and rule the sky.
Build your base – construct additional hangars and structures for your pilots and crew. Ensure its safety by building anti-aircraft artillery and barrage balloons. Develop your management skills to cut costs and manage your unit more efficiently, and become the ultimate squadron leader.
Play through varied missions in each of the available campaigns – experience deadly encounters with enemy fighters, protect ground structures from bombers, fight over the sea and weaken the enemy’s navy, pilot bombers and destroy targets of strategic value. These are only a few examples of multiple mission types that you will experience in the beautiful landscapes of Europe, Africa and Asia. Pick the best planes and pilots for the job and fly over the cold Russian tundra or sunny deserts of Egypt. Fight over the Pacific Ocean and experience the war from the perspective of American and Japanese pilots.

EXPERIENCE WW2 FLIGHT COMBAT ON MOBILE LIKE NEVER BEFORE
● The best WW2 air combat game on mobile devices with intuitive controls and user-friendly flight mechanics.
● Over 50 historical planes from RAF, Luftwaffe, American, Japanese and  Soviet Air Forces, with various customization, paint and upgrade options.
● As squadron leader, you are tasked with more than piloting your plane – you also manage the base. Buy planes, recruit and train pilots, and keep building additional structures.
● Detailed 3D graphics with awesome special effects.
● Radio chatter in American English, British English, Russian, German and Japanese to give you the full experience of a World War II dogfight.

Pilots, the update V3.2 is now live! A brand-new map, 5 ace fighters, new weapons, and a new Air Force Base season are ready to go. Dive into these exciting new features and start your next adventure today!

1. New Map: added the "Basin" combat map. Utilize complex terrain for tactical showdowns.
2. 3 New Aircrafts: introducing the B-Class Defense "F-111 Aardvark", A-Class Balanced "Mirage 4000 Super Mirage", and S-Class Agility "F-47 Avenger".
3. 2 Honor Aircrafts: added the "Q-5 Dragon Fang" and "Typhoon FGR4 Britannia", now available for exchange in the honor store.
4. New store: introduced a new exchange store. Players can now use honor coins to redeem new aircraft, weapons, and various other rare resources.
5. Season leaderboards: added season ranking rewards for top players.
6. Team-up optimization: added a "Ready" notification for parties. Friendly matches now support custom level caps for both aircraft and weapons.
7. Stage sweep: added a "Sweep" function to regional maps (unlocks at Lv. 20). Players receive 3 free sweeps per day for stages below their current level.
8. Increased Earnings: 4v4 multiplayer match medal rewards have been increased by 20%.
9. Team renaming: The team system now supports name changes using diamonds, allowing you to customize your team's identity.
10. Material synthesis: added support for combining "composite gears" into higher-tier "super gears".
11. Battle report favorites: added a "favorite" function to mail battle reports. Combat data display has also been optimized for a more intuitive overview.
12. Combat optimization: comprehensively improved the physical effects of weapon firing to simulate more realistic aerial combat hit feedback.
13. Chat environment maintenance: optimized chat room mechanics by setting daily free message limits and chat cooldowns to effectively prevent spamming.
14. Fair competition: adjusted matchmaking rules for the limited time leaderboard battle events. Rematches no longer count toward event progress, and daily challenges against the same opponent are now limited.
15. Base expansion: increased the air force base HQ level cap to 35, while optimizing stage difficulty to ensure a fun and balanced challenge.
16. Optimized air force base challenge rules. The top 10 players can challenge each other freely; ranks 11–200 can only challenge players ranked above them; unranked players will face system-recommended opponents.
17. Stability enhancements: Fixed known issues and comprehensively improved overall game performance and stability.

Fight across green hills, mountain ridges, desert outposts, ocean battlefields and the ice of Antarctica. Break convoys, challenge air defenses and take on ships, helicopters and hostile aircraft as the campaign grows tougher.

FLY YOUR WAY
Steer, climb, dive and perform loops with landscape touch controls. Bullets fly straight from your aircraft, so your aim matters. Drop bombs on precise attack runs and turn back for another pass.

BUILD YOUR HANGAR
Start with the Kestrel and unlock four more aircraft, from propeller fighters to powerful jets. Choose armor, guns and bombs with different strengths and tradeoffs. Spend coins on upgrades and diamonds on new aircraft and premium equipment.

MAKE EVERY SORTIE COUNT
Earn coins and diamonds, improve your mission results and replay your favorite battles. Play the campaign offline; purchases, ads and online services require an internet connection.

Copper Skies is free to play and includes optional in-app purchases and advertising. Optional rewarded videos grant diamonds. Automatic interstitial ads may appear between missions from mission 2 onward for eligible players. The No Ads purchase removes automatic interstitial ads; optional rewarded videos remain available.

Progress and consumable diamonds are stored on your device. There is no cloud save or cross-device currency recovery. Eligible No Ads purchases can be restored through the Bank.
